_comment: Cards that exist only for the batched token-created trigger test (tests/unit/triggers/test_batched_token_created.py). Never part of a deck list. `t_storyteller` is Staff of the Storyteller's counter line, with the 'one or more' batching; `t_greedy_storyteller` is the same trigger WITHOUT `batched`, and is the counterfactual that over-counts.

cards.name: Test Storyteller
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you create one or more creature tokens, put a story counter on this artifact.

abilities.text: Whenever you create one or more creature tokens, put a story counter on this artifact.

cards.name: Test Greedy Storyteller
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you create a creature token, put a story counter on this artifact.

abilities.text: Whenever you create a creature token, put a story counter on this artifact.
